items.summary: Recommend rejecting all new change requests, requeues, deployments, experiments, monetization changes, and spend this cycle. Continue only the existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, AI-cost, infrastructure-cost, and budget reconciliation. Amazon data covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. The $4.92 is one aggregate provider row and cannot be assigned to a site; site-attributed commission is $0. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28 and totals $901.90 across 4,926 calls, including 228 errors, so contribution margin cannot be calculated from these mismatched periods. Infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, experiment costs, approved budget ceilings, and learning thresholds are absent. Do not claim revenue, margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, cost-to-learn, or causal lift. Minimum finance evidence is a same-period ledger mapping revenue and costs to site/content/tracking identifiers, plus approved budget ceilings and a defined learning outcome with maximum cost-to-learn. Treat clicks, orders, sessions, conversions, AI calls, output counts, and treatment/control output as operating metrics only.

Reject the three queued implementation requests for financial execution this cycle. Preserve their specifications as deferred backlog only. They have no defined financial outcome, cost ceiling, or attributable revenue measurement, while existing measurement, failure-repair, ownership, release, security, rollback, deduplication, and attribution gates remain incomplete. No spend, deployment, requeue, new telemetry, or monetization change is authorized.

Retain work item 67ebb985-a7b8-47f4-9792-b4d727275c4a only; do not create duplicate finance or telemetry work. Preserve the $4.92 aggregate commission as unattributed. Reconcile matching-period provider revenue, tracking identifiers, AI cost, infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, experiments, and budget records. Escalate only after the minimum evidence is attached.
